user.title: Add InPost Air locker
user.description: How do you want to find the Paczkomat?

menu_options.map: On a map (nearest, with current temperature)

map.title: Find lockers on the map
map.description: Move the pin and set the radius. Up to {limit} nearest lockers with air sensors are checked live; only those reporting a fresh temperature are listed.

city.title: Find lockers by city
city.description: Letter case and Polish characters do not matter (e.g. dzierzoniow).

data_description.locker_code: Code printed on the Paczkomat or shown on the InPost map.

pick.title: Choose a locker
pick.description: Found {count} lockers ({hidden} skipped: no fresh temperature). The selected locker is checked live before it is added.

stale.title: Old measurements
stale.description: Locker {code} last reported data at {last} ({age} ago). Its sensors may be broken. Submit to add it anyway — entities stay unavailable until fresh data arrives.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the InPost API. Try again later.
error.catalog_unavailable: Cannot download the list of lockers. Try again later or add the locker by code.
error.invalid_code: Invalid locker code (3–32 letters and digits).
error.not_found: This locker does not exist or has no air sensors.
error.no_lockers_found: No lockers with air sensors found.
error.no_working_lockers: No nearby locker reports a fresh temperature. Increase the radius or move the pin.
error.no_temperature: This locker does not report a temperature.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to query the API, in minutes. The API publishes aggregated values, so polling more often than every few minutes brings little.
